'''2009 2K Event Day 1 Nick Glazer LS Local Uprising''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Nick Glazer]] at [[2009 2K Event]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Local Uprising / Liberation|SE-L-localuprising.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' T16LAWL
* '''Username:''' SharkyA2
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
